message: You know, sometimes I chuckle at how unprepared we can be for the little bumps in life. I once found myself scrambling for cash when my wallet slipped through the cracks of my couch! Finding ways to be financially ready can really save us from those silly moments. 🛋️ Just a little prep can go a long way in keeping our peace of mind intact. Have you ever had a funny moment of unpreparedness?
